name: Gujarat Craft Industries Limited
summary: Gujarat Craft Industries Ltd. specializes in the production and international distribution of laminated textiles and an assortment of woven sacks. The company's diverse offerings feature products such as FIBCs, biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) bags, traditional PP woven bags, protective lumber wraps, tarpaulins, GCIL-branded HDPE pipes, GCIL vermibeds, geomembranes, NFI bags, and durable polypropylene ropes. This enterprise was established on July 31, 1984, and operates from its primary base in Gandhinagar, India.
